unit_attributes.scope_text: When a storm warning is active
unit_attributes.choice_text: Unless all of the following conditions are met: (1) The demonstration takes place beneath a fixed roof; (2) The agency has measured wind speed below 20 kilometers per hour at the demonstration site within the preceding 10 minutes; and (3) An agency officer authorizes the demonstration for the duration of the current warning.
unit_attributes.statement: When a storm warning is active, the organizer must suspend outdoor demonstrations unless all of the following conditions are met: (1) the demonstration takes place beneath a fixed roof; (2) the agency has measured wind speed below 20 kilometers per hour at the demonstration site within the preceding 10 minutes; and (3) an agency officer authorizes the demonstration for the duration of the current warning.

unit_attributes.scope_text: When an agency officer authorizes an outdoor demonstration for the duration of the current warning
unit_attributes.statement: An authorization granted by an agency officer expires when the current warning ends, and it does not authorize demonstrations under a later warning.

unit_attributes.scope_text: For displays held entirely before sunset
unit_attributes.statement: For displays held entirely before sunset, the organizer should place a readable map near the entrance.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Under the recommendation for displays held entirely before sunset to place a readable map near the entrance
unit_attributes.statement: The recommendation to place a readable map near the entrance for displays held entirely before sunset does not create a duty to illuminate exits after sunset.
The organizer must retain each inspection record for at least 30 calendar days after the display closes, with weekends and holidays counting toward the 30 days.

unit_attributes.scope_text: After the display closes, if an investigation is open when the 30-calendar-day period ends
unit_attributes.statement: If an investigation is open when the 30-calendar-day retention period ends, the organizer must retain the inspection record until the agency closes the investigation.
Visitors are not required to supply their home addresses.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Subject to other premises rules that may restrict particular materials
unit_attributes.statement: This policy does not prohibit visitors from bringing paper maps, but other premises rules may restrict particular materials.
Other premises rules may restrict particular materials.
A queue may form when several groups arrive together.
